observed_sequence.observation: The robot stands facing the table; the empty left hand rests near the bouquet, and the right arm hangs down.
The left arm extends outward and raises the empty hand; the wrist changes orientation in preparation for reaching the stems. The bouquet remains lying on the table.
The left hand descends toward the bouquet stem and leaf cluster beside the vase.
The left fingers close around the green stems below the flower heads while the flowers initially remain near the tabletop; small grip adjustments occur.
The closed left hand lifts the bouquet clear of the table, raising the blossoms and rotating the stems from a roughly horizontal position toward downward.
The left hand continues orienting the bouquet upright, holding the gathered stems with their free ends below the hand.
The left arm carries the upright bouquet inward over the pink vase and aligns the downward stem ends above its opening.
The left hand lowers the stem ends through the vase opening; increasing lengths of the stems disappear inside the vase.
The hand lowers the bouquet farther into the vase and tilts it to one side, keeping its grasp close to the mouth.
The left fingers open and separate from the stem bundle; the bouquet remains resting in the vase.
The left hand withdraws sideways and lowers beside the body. The vase remains upright, with the pink rose bouquet supported inside and leaning to one side; no second manipulation follows.
